page.notes: Black letter words in the text ("In hundred", "Bu-sheli") are set in Gothic type; their readings are approximate. The "§" and "ꝺ" signs before them are uncertain. The line-end "Bu-" to "sheli" is split across lines and was written as one word with its printed hyphen. The text is cut off at the bottom of this scan and continues on the next part. Text is set in roman type with long s; the first line is partly cut at the top. Some words in the middle of lines are faint or damaged, e.g. "jurantem", "utrinque", "contrahentium" and "consensisse" are read from a worn print and may be imperfect. The text as printed reads "nulla, facta fit mentio", "ex antegressis", "Juramentum", and "praestandū", transcribed as shown.
